In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
chronic illness is not a disease, but an experience that is socially constructed and technologically mediated.
the design and implementation of technology is a complex and multi-dimensional process, which is influenced by many social, economic and political factors.
the future of health technologies in chronic illness is a future of dualism.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the design of health technology is not a neutral act, but a political one, which shapes and constrains the ways in which people live with chronic illness.
the duality of health technologies in chronic illness is not a problem but a challenge for design and research.
technology is both a solution and a problem.

we should be more aware of the duality of health technologies.
